mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_outbox (notification_id, event_type, payload) VALUES (#{notificationId}, #{eventType}, COALESCE(#{payload}, '{}'))
mapper.select: SELECT id, notification_id, event_type, payload, published_at, delivered_at, error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM notification_outbox WHERE published_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_outbox SET published_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND published_at IS NULL
UPDATE notification_outbox SET delivered_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND delivered_at IS NULL
UPDATE notification_outbox SET error_message = #{message}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
